permissionMode.description: Default permission behavior for tool execution.

permissionAllow.description: Legacy allow rules in <tool:match> format. Migrated into policy v2 at runtime.

permissionDeny.description: Legacy deny rules in <tool:match> format. Migrated into policy v2 at runtime.

extensionToolEnforcement.description: Require requiredPermission metadata for extension tools in auto mode.

enabled.description: Enable Linux bubblewrap sandbox for process-based tools.

showImages.description: Render images inline when the terminal supports it.

clearOnShrink.description: Clear trailing rows when content shrinks to avoid stale artifacts.

compactFooter.description: Use a compact single-line footer layout.

enabled.description: Enable built-in web search tool integration.

providerMode.description: Primary web search provider selection strategy.

fallbackMode.description: Fallback provider policy when primary lookup fails.

batchMode.description: Batch execution mode for verification runners that support command batching.

maxParallel.description: Maximum concurrent commands when verification.batchMode is parallel.

readBeforeMutateMode.description: Read-before-mutate runtime guard mode for edit/write/apply_patch flows.

repeatedFailureMode.description: Loop-break guard mode for repeated identical tool failures in a single turn.

repeatedFailureLimit.description: Consecutive failure threshold before repeated-failure guard warns/blocks.

misrouteMode.description: Warn when bash is used for operations covered by active specialized tools.

botToken.description: Telegram bot token for Bot API access.

allowedUserIds.description: Allowlist of Telegram user IDs permitted to control the bridge (non-numeric values are ignored at runtime).

statusEditThrottleMs.description: Minimum milliseconds between live status edits in Telegram.

maxSummaryChars.description: Max characters in final chat summary before attaching full output as a file.

apiMax429Retries.description: Retry attempts for Telegram API 429 responses (runtime clamped to 0..10).

apiMaxNetworkRetries.description: Retry attempts for transient Telegram API network/server failures (runtime clamped to 0..10).

apiNetworkBackoffInitialMs.description: Initial backoff delay for Telegram API retries (runtime clamped to 250..60000).

apiNetworkBackoffMaxMs.description: Maximum backoff delay for Telegram API retries (runtime clamped to 500..300000 and >= initial).

pollingBackoffInitialMs.description: Initial polling loop backoff after transient failures (runtime clamped to 500..60000).

pollingBackoffMaxMs.description: Maximum polling loop backoff after transient failures (runtime clamped to 1000..300000 and >= initial).

statusEditNetworkRetryMs.description: Retry delay for status edit network failures (runtime clamped to 1000..60000).

pollingTrace.description: Enable verbose polling/update tracing in terminal logs for Telegram bridge.
